newsitem.title: USA: Borg-Warner Auto can't account for rise.
newsitem.headline: Borg-Warner Auto can't account for rise.

text.p: Borg-Warner Automotive Corp said Monday there are no corporate developments to account for a rise of almost seven percent in its stock price.
"There are no corporate developments that we are aware of," said Mary Brevard, spokeswoman for the company, which supplies components and systems for the automotive industry.
Shares of Borg-Warner Automotive were trading up 3-5/8, to 54-1/8, after trading as high as 54-3/4 on the day.
She said the company remains comfortable with analysts' estimates for second quarter earnings of $1.25 a share and expects to report second quarter financial results July 23.
Borg-Warner Automotive reported earnings of $0.93 in the 1996 second quarter.
